changelog: New: One-command Claude desktop setup — `densa-deck mcp config` emits a paste-ready config block with your install's exe path auto-resolved (closes the PATH gap that bit Inno-installer customers in v0.4.0).
New: `densa-deck mcp selftest` verifies the server side works without involving Claude desktop. Reports tool count + tier, exits 0/1.
New: Settings → AI client integration (MCP) panel — Show config, Copy to clipboard, Verify connection. Click-driven equivalent for non-CLI users.
Prior: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server — drive Densa Deck from Claude desktop / ulcagent / Cursor / any AI client (shipped in v0.4.0).
Prior: Operator controls — kill switch (env or config), --read-only mode, --tools whitelist (shipped in v0.4.0).
